> Luna will be a little robot character with purple hair, white armor, and a pink heart. I want her to react to what is happening on the computer instead of playing the same animation all the time. When the PC is quiet, she could rest or look around. When it is working harder, she could switch to a running or working animation. Finishing a study session could trigger a small celebration. If the computer stops sending data, the display should show that it is disconnected instead of leaving old numbers on the screen. The character will use prepared 2D animation frames with a rendered 3D look. I am not planning to render a full 3D model on the ESP32 or add a chatbot in the first version.
